claim_card.objects: Gamma : IntegralCycle, U : Set Complex open with Gamma.trace subset U, F : Complex -> Complex complex differentiable on U.
claim_card.exact_per_curve_conclusion: For every i : Fin Gamma.count, integral_0^1 Gamma.velocity_i(s) * deriv_C F(Gamma.curve_i(s)) ds = F(Gamma.curve_i(1)) - F(Gamma.curve_i(0)).
claim_card.integral_domain: Lebesgue interval integral of complex scalar functions on [0,1]; finite sum over all indexed curve occurrences.
claim_card.exceptions_and_requirements: No C1, Lipschitz, piecewise-smooth, injectivity, positive speed or nonzero count premise on the curves. F is a supplied single-valued primitive, holomorphic on an open neighborhood of the trace. Only Complex scalar codomain is stated.
claim_card.recorded_evidence: Fresh independent candidate compiler exit 0 on final SHA, plus source-level proof audit. Imported baseline dependencies not independently rebuilt in this invocation.

raw_representation.fields: count : Nat; base : Fin count -> Complex; velocity : Fin count -> Real -> Complex; velocity_integrable : for every i, IntervalIntegrable velocity_i volume 0 1; closed : integral_0^1 velocity_i = 0.
raw_representation.trace: Union of images of all Gamma.curve_i on uIcc 0 1.
raw_representation.meaning: Actual L1 complex velocities, rather than a scalar proxy or conclusion-valued certificate. Endpoint closure follows from integral velocity zero. Values outside [0,1] may be arbitrary.

obligations.name: Coordinate reconstruction and transport of complex primitive integral
obligations.evidence: Both coordinates are interval integrable; CLMs commute with each 0..s integral for every s in [0,1]. AC sum of embedded real primitive and I times embedded imaginary primitive agrees pointwise with complex primitive.

obligations.name: All intervals 0..s used in coordinate transport are integrable
obligations.evidence: hg.mono_set with uIcc_subset_uIcc_left hs, for hs : s in uIcc 0 1.

obligations.name: Holomorphic to Lipschitz on arbitrary compact trace
obligations.evidence: Each trace point has an actual ambient neighborhood contained in U where F is C1 and Lipschitz. Pinned compact local-to-global theorem needs no convexity or connectedness assumption on trace.

obligations.name: AC composition stays in required Lipschitz set
obligations.evidence: For every s in uIcc 0 1, witness (i,s,hs,rfl) shows curve_i(s) in Gamma.trace.

obligations.name: A.e. chain rule uses actual velocity and correct coefficient domains
obligations.evidence: Raw velocity derivative theorem is over Real, derivative of F is over Complex; HasDerivAt.scomp supports scalar towers and produces velocity smul deriv F. No coordinate surrogate used.

obligations.name: Endpoint cancellation and signs
obligations.evidence: g=F(curve)-integral(integrand) is constant; primitive at zero is zero, so integral equals F(curve(1))-F(curve(0)); raw closed velocities give curve(1)=curve(0)=base.

obligations.name: Arbitrary interval-integrable velocities, including unbounded or discontinuous L1 representatives
obligations.evidence: All regularity is derived from integrable velocity primitives. Lebesgue differentiation is a.e.; no pointwise differentiability of velocity is used.

obligations.name: Endpoint derivative failures or arbitrary data outside interval
obligations.evidence: Pinned local primitive differentiation theorem explicitly discards endpoint null sets; a.e. zero derivative plus AC yields pointwise constancy including endpoints.

obligations.name: Repeated loops, reversals, self intersections, zero speed
obligations.evidence: Proof runs independently for every indexed occurrence and uses no geometric exclusion. Each exact derivative integral vanishes.

obligations.name: Zero count / empty trace / empty open U

obligations.evidence: The input is F, and the integrated function is deriv F; no statement constructs F for a supplied holomorphic integrand.
